project: MASH Landing Page - UI/UX Redesign & Production Polish

rules.noGradients: Solid colors only for backgrounds - NO gradients (except the Download section green bg which is brand-intentional)
rules.designSystem: Always use Button and Card components from components/ui/ - never use raw inline-styled buttons or cards
rules.solidColorsOnly: All backgrounds must use CSS custom properties and solid colors. No bg-gradient-to-* classes.
rules.description: AI agent must read this file after completing tasks to verify completion. No emojis allowed in any output or file. All tasks must pass verification checks before marking complete.

designPrinciples.summary: Professional, clean, conversion-focused SaaS landing page inspired by Stripe, Linear, and Vercel aesthetics.

principles.name: Visual Hierarchy
principles.rule: Every section must have a clear primary action. Use size, weight, and color contrast to guide the eye: Headline > Subtitle > Body > Supporting text.

principles.name: Consistent Design System
principles.rule: All buttons MUST use components/ui/button.tsx. All card-like elements MUST use components/ui/card.tsx. No inline-styled alternatives.

principles.name: Progressive Disclosure
principles.rule: Show essential info first, reveal details on interaction. No section should show more than 6 items without a 'Show more' mechanism.

principles.name: Scroll-Driven Storytelling
principles.rule: Every section must use ScrollReveal for entrance animations. Content should feel alive, not dumped onto the page.

principles.name: Reduce, Reuse
principles.rule: Homepage should have 7-8 focused sections max. Consolidate overlapping content (Features + Scope into one). Remove placeholder content.

principles.name: Mobile-First Interactions
principles.rule: All interactive elements must work on touch. Minimum touch targets 48x48px. Swipe gestures where expected.

principles.name: Performance Budget
principles.rule: Total page weight under 3MB (excluding lazy-loaded 3D model). All images via Sanity CDN with auto-format. Draco-compress GLB.

principles.name: Accessibility
principles.rule: WCAG 2.1 AA minimum. All color contrasts must pass. Reduced-motion users see no animations. Skip-to-content link on every page.

borders.input: border border-default rounded-lg focus:border-green-500 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-green-500/20

animations.entrance: ScrollReveal with direction='up', delay staggered at 0.1s intervals

colors.accent: Only green. No blue/purple accents on primary sections.

pages.name: Homepage
pages.notes: Reduced from 10 to 7-8 sections. Removed: DocumentationSection (moved to /documentation), ScopeSection (merged into Features), SupportSection (moved to /support). DemoSection hidden until real videos exist.

ScopeSection - overlaps heavily with FeaturesSection, merge key points into Features
SupportSection - content lives at /support, link in Footer is sufficient
DemoSection - hidden until real demo video content is available
